name: Super Record S Wireless front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 130 g for the braze-on Super Record S Wireless twelve-speed double front derailleur, FDSRS-2WL. The product page does not state battery inclusion for this figure; no battery mass is added or deducted and no clamp adapter is selected. This is not a weight for the original FD23-SR12WRL.
